description: This Java class defines a Fragment called SetupProfileFragment which handles initiating managed profile provisioning on Android devices. It includes UI setup, intent creation for device provisioning, and result handling.

classes.name: SetupProfileFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that manages the initiation of managed profile provisioning and handles user interaction for setting up a managed profile.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout for setting up the profile.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets the click listener on the profile setup button.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events, triggers provisioning when the setup button is clicked.

methods.name: provisionManagedProfile
methods.description: Creates an intent to start managed profile provisioning, adds extras based on Android version, and launches the intent.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the provisioning process, displaying success or failure messages.
